title: A Size measurement is one group: a faint red box over the area plus its width and height
goal: Measuring the size of something puts down one thing, not two loose calipers: a group named for what it measures (for example 'Size 320 x 48') holding a box that tints the measured area in the Size colour at 10% opacity, the width caliper and the height caliper. The group moves, hides and deletes as one, and expands in the Layers list so each of its three parts can be picked and changed.
notes:
User's words (2026-10-13): "when i measure the size of a box, i'd like the box to have a semitransparent (10% opacity) red box outlining the space being measured. I'd like the size tool to be one layer group but can be expanded to modify the 3 parts."

From code reading (not run): EditorState+Measure.swift addElementSize (:97-135) builds a width and a height MeasureContent (role .size, Size ink when measureRolesEnabled), plans readouts, and adds the two layers loose (perform { addLayer(width); addLayer(height) }), placed in time on video. No box, no group. Groups exist (GroupContent); the spec list names Width/Height from role .size (PhotonzCore/MeasureSpecList.swift:41). Memory: the user's main use is UX redlining.
acceptance: Size mode (hover click, rough box, or [ / ] picks) commits one group containing: a rectangle exactly over the measured area (no stroke, fill in the Size role's colour, red by default, at 10% opacity, editable like any shape's fill and opacity), the width caliper and the height caliper (as today, readouts placed the same way)
The group's name says the size ('Size 320 x 48', using the document's unit) and updates if a part is edited; in the Layers list it is collapsed by default and expands to show Box, Width, Height

Picking the group on the canvas picks it whole (moving it moves all three, Delete removes all three, one undo step); double click or the Layers list picks a part; the box's fill, the calipers' colours and readouts are editable on the part
The Measurements panel lists the group as one size entry with its two numbers; Copy as Spec List and the copied redline still give Width and Height as today
The box tint is legible-safe: it never hides what is under it (10% default), and the Size style in the Library can change its default colour and opacity for new measurements
Existing documents with loose width and height calipers open unchanged

A walk measures a button in Size mode, checks one group with three children, checks the box's fill opacity is 10% and colour is the Size colour, moves the group, expands it and changes the box opacity
Audit under queue/audits/; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not.

log.note: Adversarial review before building: a Photoshop user expects a measurement they can move as one and open to edit, which groups give. Risks found: the box could be read as an element by Size mode's own reader (excluded in LayerElements), readouts and foot snapping only looked at top-level calipers (now read every caliper in canvas space), box fill/opacity edits would have armed the rectangle tool (now remembered for the next Size box instead), and picking the group showed group Layout rows (Arrangement, Hug/Fixed) that mean nothing for a measurement (now hidden for a Size group and its parts).

Built: PhotonzCore/MeasureSizeGroup.swift (builder, automatic name 'Size 274 × 62', keepSizeMeasureNamesInStep run in every perform), GroupContent.measuresSize (written only when true), MeasureStyles.sizeBoxColorPick/sizeBoxOpacity (box follows Size ink until picked), MeasureSpecList rows/spec lines for groups, LayerElements/MeasureSnapping/Contents/Placement selections. App: addElementSize builds the group when next-layer-groups is on (Current keeps loose calipers), Measurements row value/swatch, box memory routing. Harness: new expectSizeMeasure step (lock-safe, documented). Tests: MeasureSizeGroupTests (25).

Verified: Scripts/test.sh 12914 tests passed. Walk a-size-measurement-is-one-group-walk green at Next defaults: one group of Box/Width/Height, box 10% in caliper ink at the measured rect, picked whole, Shift-Right moves all three, one undo step, Layers rows Size/Height/Width/Box, Box opacity to 25, next box starts at 25, Delete removes all three, spec list still Width + Height lines. Updated walks expecting loose calipers: dock-picked-first, measure-row-menu, number-keeps-clear, size-measures-a-drawn-shape; 38 Size-touching walks green.

Name format uses × (as the spec list header already does) rather than the x in the task's example. 'Size style in the Library' does not exist (the Library has no measure styles); met instead by remember-last-edit, the app's convention, and said in the audit's rough. Left rough (not filed, unverified): dragging the picked group's corner handle resizes it like any group, which likely stretches the calipers' placement rather than re-measuring; if the user reacts to that audit line it becomes a task.

Size mode commits one group 'Size 274 × 62' (Box at 10% in Size ink over the measured area + Width + Height): moves/hides/undoes/deletes as one, opens in Layers as Box/Width/Height, one Size row in Measurements, spec list unchanged, box colour/opacity remembered for the next measurement. Core MeasureSizeGroup + tests (12914 pass); walk a-size-measurement-is-one-group-walk green at Next defaults; audit queue/audits/2026-10-13-size-measurement-group.json.
